scope: Offline validation of daily-energy diagnostic evidence and aware timestamp serialization; no guard, numeric energy formula or polling changes.
regressions: Original coordinator output lacked detached per-value evidence; real coordinator assertions failed before implementation.
Cached values preserve original recursive acquisition lineage through failed energy reads, the actual LOCAL interval-skip path and PV-string carry-forward.
An equal-valued fresh chart response replaces prior local evidence with explicit missing lineage.
Mixed-day, HTTP, missing, unknown and empty contributor trees remain ineligible; member loss and GridBOSS CT/phase overlays follow numeric source selection.
Aware datetime offsets and precision survive serialization; plant IDs matching ISO years or fractional seconds do not corrupt timestamp values.
Repeated diagnostics capture timestamps change without refreshing cached acquisition times; naive datetimes and unknown objects retain bounded placeholders.
contract_limits: Daily counters are derived from present sensor keys with reset_period=daily; lifetime counters are outside this evidence projection.

Evidence value is the raw coordinator value before HA entity guard presentation. accepted_for_daily_guard expresses diagnostic eligibility, not actual guard expiration, device reset, counter day or hardware validation.
Source identifiers and free-form field names are omitted; recursive contributor structure does not identify physical contributors.
Future equal-valued source replacements need explicit evidence updates at their assignment sites; numeric reconciliation alone cannot detect them.
Cloud, battery and chart device-counter-day semantics remain unresolved. This change does not add runtime poll durations or establish transport fallback/recovery.
